evidence.finding: Maintainer describes mixed licenses and files without a listed license; this is not a blanket grant.
Themaister introduced the predecessor bloom code in 2014; no license grant found in the inspected addition.
Themaister moved bloom files into crt/glow.
Hyllian moved the Cg files into crt/shaders/glow in 2015.
rz5 translated Glow shaders/presets to Slang in 2016; inspected additions have no explicit license grant.
hunterk added curvature and moire compensation in 2018; current resolve.slang credits Themaister and Timothy Lottes.
Hyllian describes LUT1/LUT2 as representing his Trinitron displays; provenance evidence, not an explicit standalone LUT license grant.
hunterk introduced the port. Five shader files include J. Kyle Pittman CC0 notices. See curated evidence for original implementation/textures; port/preset scope remains under review.

GPL v2 section 9 permits any FSF-published GPL version when the program specifies no version. Record EasyMode/aperture as GPL without version; comply under GPLv3 without replacing original notices. No separate version permission is needed on that basis.

Original author implementation is CC0-1.0. Original crtbase.fx carries the CC0 notice, and both bundled textures match the author BMPs pixel-for-pixel. Original scope evidenced; separately review new Slang port/preset contributions.

All six selected mask textures match the author family pixel-for-pixel; GPL family LICENSE.TXT is byte-identical (Git blob d8cf7d463e2a4f064a157fa994bb394d3623b9cc). Author preset references these masks. Supports family provenance; does not by itself settle later port contributions.

conclusion: All seven presets retained unchanged. Original CRTSim code/assets and Royale mask provenance are documented. Remaining scope questions are transparently recorded and accepted under the owner release policy, not automatic shader release blockers. This is not a blanket license grant. Native dependency packaging checks remain separate.
